revisions.note: Resumed from the rev-1 seed. The tracer gained the modes the briq names (--self-test, --capture SECONDS + JSONL under the repository archive path, sysfs capability discovery, 1440x3040 coordinate validation, per-layer exit codes). Grading a REAL live capture exposed three bugs (a layer-4 crash on a zero-device shim scan, a console command frame read as device output, and the analyzer grading its own previous verdict); all three are fixed and regression-gated. The live device is in charger/LPM mode, so no touch evidence exists on this boot and none is claimed.
